command:
set -euo pipefail
echo HOST=$(hostname) USER=$(id -un)
echo SELF_INTEGRATION_HEAD=$(git -C /home/andreas/self-integration rev-parse HEAD 2>/dev/null || echo MISSING)
systemctl show entityos-vm.service -p ActiveState -p MainPID -p ActiveEnterTimestamp -p DropInPaths -p ExecCondition -p ExecStopPost --no-pager
for p in /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/10-volatile-state-guard.conf /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf /etc/systemd/system/entityos-vm.service.d/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf.pre-stage-disabled /var/lib/entityos/data/cutover-control/20-semantic-state-cutover.conf.pre-stage /usr/local/libexec/entityos/fluechtig-vor-start-pruefen.sh /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py /var/lib/entityos/data/semantic-state/CUTOVER.json; do if sudo -n test -e "$p"; then printf 'EXISTS %s ' "$p"; sudo -n sha256sum "$p" || true; else echo MISSING $p; fi; done
echo CONFIG; sudo -n grep -E '^(ENTITYOS_ROOTFS_RUN|ENTITYOS_DATA_DIR|ENTITYOS_IDENTITY_BINDS)=' /etc/entityos/entityos.conf || true
echo CUTOVER_INSPECT
sudo -n /usr/local/libexec/entityos/semantic-state-cutover.py --config /etc/entityos/entityos.conf --service entityos-vm.service inspect || true
echo VOLATILE_DB_INVENTORY
sudo -n find /var/lib/entityos/rootfs-run/root/.local/share -type f \( -name '*.db' -o -name '*.db.*' \) -printf '%p %s\n' 2>/dev/null | sort || true
